headline: Microsoft closed the actively exploited RoguePlanet Defender zero-day as researchers turned popular AI coding assistants into fresh attack vectors and Interpol swept up 5,811 fraud suspects worldwide.

emerging_trends.text: Researchers keep turning autonomous AI coding assistants against their own users, with GhostApproval symlink tricks and the Friendly Fire proof-of-concept both coaxing tools like Claude Code and Cursor into running attacker-supplied code on developer machines.
emerging_trends.topic_title: AI Coding Assistants Coaxed Into Running Malicious Code

emerging_trends.text: Extortion crews are industrializing Microsoft 365 account takeover, as the Pink crew fakes Entra passkey enrollment over the phone and the AI-assisted Forg365 platform mass-produces adversary-in-the-middle lures.
emerging_trends.topic_title: M365 Account Theft via Forg365 and Fake Passkeys

emerging_trends.text: Microsoft shipped the RoguePlanet Defender fix nearly a month after researcher NightmareEclipse dropped a public exploit, showing how researcher-vendor standoffs leave privilege-escalation holes open.

topics.title: RoguePlanet Defender Zero-Day Patched
topics.latest_developments: Microsoft shipped a Malware Protection Engine update July 9 fixing CVE-2026-50656, the RoguePlanet Windows Defender privilege-escalation zero-day, nearly a month after researcher NightmareEclipse published a proof-of-concept.
topics.summary: CVE-2026-50656, an improper link-resolution flaw in mpengine.dll, lets an authenticated attacker gain SYSTEM on Windows 10 and 11; Ars Technica notes a related weakness lets attackers fill a victim's hard disk. Windows administrators should confirm the engine update deployed.

sources.title: Microsoft Patches Defender 'RoguePlanet' Vulnerability
Microsoft patches RoguePlanet Defender zero-day vulnerability
Microsoft Patches RoguePlanet Defender Flaw That Can Grant SYSTEM Privileges
Patch for Windows Defender 0-day could allow attackers to fill hard disk

topics.title: AI Coding Assistants Coaxed Into Running Malicious Code
topics.latest_developments: Wiz disclosed GhostApproval symlink flaws in six coding assistants July 9, the same day the AI Now Institute published Friendly Fire and the Alan Turing Institute detailed a Copilot jailbreak.
topics.summary: GhostApproval abuses symbolic-link handling so a booby-trapped repository redirects an approved write onto a sensitive file in Amazon Q Developer, Claude Code, Augment, Cursor, Google Antigravity, and Windsurf; Friendly Fire tricks Claude Code and OpenAI Codex in autonomous mode into executing the very code they scan, and Turing researchers found GitHub Copilot refuses harm in chat while writing it in code.

sources.title: AI Coding Tools Tricked Into Hacking Developer Machine via Decades-Old Technique

Top AI Agents Built to Catch Malicious Code Can Be Tricked Into Running It

topics.title: Breaches Hit KDDI, AssuranceAmerica, and Mount Royal University
topics.latest_developments: Japanese telco KDDI, US insurer AssuranceAmerica, and Calgary's Mount Royal University each disclosed intrusions July 9.
topics.summary: Hackers exploited a zero-day in a third-party system to reach a KDDI ISP email platform, exposing 12 million people; AssuranceAmerica disclosed a breach of nearly 7 million drivers; and Mount Royal University confirmed a ransomware crew reached its internal network and deleted two drives holding employee, student, and university data.

sources.title: 12 Million Impacted by Data Breach at Japanese Telco KDDI
AssuranceAmerica data breach exposes records of 6.9 million drivers
Mount Royal University Confirms Data Stolen in Ransomware Attack

topics.title: Operation First Light 2026 Nets 5,811 Arrests
topics.latest_developments: Interpol's four-month Operation First Light 2026 wrapped with 5,811 arrests and $293 million in assets seized across 97 countries.
topics.summary: The campaign targeted social-engineering scams—criminals posing as police officers, romantic partners, and business suppliers—and the money laundering that moves their proceeds. Investigators intercepted the seized funds across the participating jurisdictions.

sources.title: 5,811 arrests, $293 million seized over social engineering scams
Police arrests 5,800 suspects in global anti-fraud crackdown

topics.title: M365 Account Theft via Forg365 and Fake Passkeys
topics.latest_developments: BleepingComputer detailed the Forg365 phishing platform and Help Net Security exposed the Pink crew's fake passkey ploy on July 9.
topics.summary: Forg365 is a phishing-as-a-service operation that blends adversary-in-the-middle, device-code methods, and AI-generated lures to steal Microsoft 365 accounts; the Pink extortion crew cold-calls employees posing as IT and walks them through a fake Entra passkey enrollment to seize their accounts. Train staff to reject unsolicited passkey setup requests.

sources.title: New Forg365 phishing platform uses AI to target Microsoft 365 accounts
Extortion crew hijacks Microsoft 365 accounts via fake passkey setup

topics.title: Poisoned Injective SDK and Fake 7-Zip Installers
topics.latest_developments: BleepingComputer found a wallet-stealing npm package inside the compromised Injective Labs SDK, and Infoblox exposed the Lurking Lizard proxy operation, both July 9.
topics.summary: Attackers hijacked Injective Labs' GitHub repository to publish an npm package that steals cryptocurrency wallet private keys and seed phrases, while Lurking Lizard's fake 7-Zip installers—served from more than 230 lookalike domains since August 2022—conscript victim devices into a residential proxy network.

sources.title: Injective SDK on npm infected with cryptocurrency wallet stealer
Fake 7-Zip Installers Turn Devices Into Residential Proxy Nodes

business_politics.title: Markets Shrug Off Renewed Iran Strikes
business_politics.latest_developments: Israel warned Washington that Tehran weighed a fresh attempt on President Trump's life and U.S. forces bombed Iranian railway bridges near Khamenei's burial city, yet oil futures fell and U.S. stocks rose as traders judged the flare-up contained.
business_politics.summary: The United States struck Iranian railway bridges on the route to Mashhad, where Iran interred supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei on Friday, while Israel told the U.S. that Iran considered a new plot to kill Trump; even so, oil settled lower and the Nasdaq led stocks higher as investors rotated back into chipmakers and bet the conflict stays boxed in.

around_town.title: Pittsburgh Restores Its Public Water Fountains
around_town.latest_developments: The city says nearly every operable public water fountain now runs, two years after a plumber shortage left many dry.
around_town.summary: Pittsburgh reports that almost every functional public drinking fountain is now working, a turnaround from 2024 when the city had a single plumber to open fountains, spray parks, and pools; Mayor Ed Gainey's administration has since built its plumbing staff to three plumbers and an apprentice.
